repos.evidence: From Lina Mezdour's own GitHub account; repo name explicitly includes 'LI' (Loop Interchange) and 'Tiling', description mentions Tiramisu polyhedral compiler and deep learning for auto-scheduling, directly matching the paper's topic.

repos.desc: This project aims to improve scalability in the auto-scheduler of Tiramisu, a polyhedral compiler. Our approach is to implement intelligent models (using Deep Learning) that predicts the best parameters of two code transformations: Loop Interchange and Loop Tiling.
